decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-logging` → `logback-classic`. Boot 3.5.15 BOM manages Logback 1.5.34 (well above 1.5.19). Exploit needs Janino + writable logback config; Petclinic uses default Spring logging. Fix: raise Boot to 3.5.15 in `build.gradle` plugin and `pom.xml` parent (no ad-hoc pin required).

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `jackson-databind` and Jackson modules from Boot starters (JSON, Actuator). Boot 3.5.15 ships Jackson BOM 2.21.4 (fixes PTV-related core issues through 2.21.4); highest advisory line for 2.19.x is 2.21.7—override `jackson-bom.version` like existing Tomcat/Thymeleaf overrides if 2.21.4 is insufficient. Async-parser DoS mainly affects non-blocking/reactive parsing; Petclinic is servlet MVC but still parses JSON on every API request.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-json`, Actuator, and tests. Same BOM bump to Boot 3.5.15 plus optional `jackson-bom.version=2.21.7` for the latest 2.21.x backports. Several CVEs require polymorphic typing, `@JsonView`/`@JsonUnwrapped`, or binding `Path`/`InetAddress` from untrusted JSON—Petclinic uses conventional DTO binding, but REST endpoints still deserialize attacker-controlled JSON.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-actuator` → `micrometer-jakarta9`. Fixed in Micrometer 1.15.12, which Boot 3.5.15 imports. Petclinic enables Actuator at runtime; crafted HTTP/gRPC to metrics paths is the stated attack surface.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `log4j-to-slf4j` in Boot logging starter (bridge only; Logback is the backend). Boot 3.5.15 still manages Log4j 2.24.3—override `log4j2.version` to 2.25.5 in Gradle `ext` and Maven `<properties>`, matching the Tomcat override pattern. Impact is malformed JSON from `MapMessage` with non-finite floats when using JsonTemplateLayout message resolvers—not typical Petclinic log layouts.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Declared directly in `build.gradle` (`runtimeOnly`) and `pom.xml` (runtime scope) without a version; resolved from the Boot BOM. Boot 3.5.15 raises the BOM to 42.7.11 (SCRAM DoS + partial channel-binding fixes) but CVE-2026-54291 needs 42.7.12—set `postgresql.version=42.7.12` in properties/ext. Only affects deployments using PostgreSQL profile/driver; default dev uses H2.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive through all Boot starters (also appears as compile dependency of the starter graph). CVE-2026-40973 fixed in 3.5.14+; bump Gradle plugin and Maven parent to 3.5.15. Local attacker + persistent sessions (`server.servlet.session.persistent=true`)—unusual for Petclinic defaults.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via starters. Embedded Artemis predictable data path; Petclinic does not use embedded Artemis—low practical risk, fixed in Boot 3.5.15 per advisory.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct `runtimeOnly` (Gradle) / compile (Maven) dependency; version comes entirely from Boot 3.5.0. Actuator health-group / Cloud Foundry path auth bypass fixed in Boot 3.5.12+; 3.5.15 satisfies. Petclinic exposes Actuator—review security config when upgrading.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`. Boot 3.5.15 imports Spring Data BOM 2025.0.12 (3.5.12 line). DoS via property paths, sort parsing, and `@ProjectedPayload`—relevant where JPA web sorting or projections accept attacker input.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via the Spring Boot dependency set. Boot 3.5.15 manages Spring Framework 6.2.19 (≥ 6.2.11). Matters only if `@EnableMethodSecurity` is used on generic hierarchy methods—verify Spring Security usage separately.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-webmvc`. Fixed in 6.2.19 with Boot 3.5.15. SpEL DoS requires evaluating attacker-supplied expressions; Petclinic does not expose SpEL by default.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-web`. Boot 3.5.15 → Framework 6.2.19 covers SSRF host-parsing fix (6.2.19) and RFD via `ContentDisposition` (6.2.8+). RFD needs user-derived filenames with non-ASCII charset in Content-Disposition.

Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-web`. Boot 3.5.15 lifts Framework to 6.2.19, which addresses most HIGH/MEDIUM items but remains inside the affected range for CVE-2026-47884/47890; vendor fix is Spring Framework 7.0.9 only (no 6.2.20 on Central). Full CRITICAL remediation implies Spring Boot 4.0.8+ (major Boot bump, Framework 7.x). XsltView RCE and SSE corruption need niche MVC view config; static-resource and redirect issues are broader but Tomcat defaults mitigate some path cases.
